title: The 8 Best Tape Measure with Laser 2026
h1: The 8 Best Tape Measure with Laser 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for tape measure with laser 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at tape measure with laser 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Bosch GLM165-27CGL Blaze Green-Beam Laser Distance Measure
products.blurb: Key specs: Green beam laser, 4x brighter than red laser, 165-foot (50m) range, Backlit color display.
strengths: Green beam is visible in bright shop lighting where red lasers wash out
165-foot range covers any room or shop span
Backlit color display is readable at arm's length or in dim conditions
Bluetooth app integration creates floor plans and saves measurements
limitations: Green beam uses more battery than red, slightly shorter battery life
features: Green beam laser, 4x brighter than red laser
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: DEWALT DW099S Laser Distance Measure with Bluetooth
products.blurb: Key specs: 100-foot (30m) range, ±1/16 inch accuracy, One-button operation.
strengths: ±1/16 inch accuracy is the standard woodworking tolerance, suitable for lumber takeoffs
One-button operation is the simplest interface, reduce fumbling with a tape measure
DEWALT brand matches tool inventory for many woodworkers
Auto-leveling detects when the unit is tilted and flags unreliable readings
limitations: Red beam becomes difficult to see in direct sunlight or bright LED shop lighting
100-foot range is adequate for most shops but limited for large jobsites

products.name: Klein Tools 93LDM200 Laser Distance Measure, 200-Foot
products.blurb: Key specs: 200-foot (60m) range, USB-rechargeable battery, Area, volume, and indirect measurement modes.
strengths: 200-foot range and USB-rechargeable battery at a lower price than Bosch or Leica
Area and volume calculation built-in, measures room size automatically
Klein Tools build quality is a step up from generic import brands
Backlit display readable in dim shop conditions
limitations: Green beam not included at this price point, red beam only
Fewer smart features than Bluetooth-connected competitors
features: Area, volume, and indirect measurement modes
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Leica DISTO D2 New 330ft Laser Distance Measure with Bluetooth 4.0
products.blurb: Key specs: 330-foot (100m) range, ±1/16 inch accuracy, Bluetooth Smart.
strengths: Leica is the professional reference standard for distance measurement, the most accurate and reliable brand
330-foot range covers the longest spans encountered in construction
Bluetooth Smart exports measurements directly to apps and CAD software
Swiss engineering longevity, survives job site abuse longer than plastic-body alternatives
limitations: Range and precision exceed most woodworking needs, overkill for a hobby shop
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: RYOBI RBLDM20 20M Laser Distance Meter
products.blurb: Key specs: 20-meter (65-foot) laser range, Compact one-button design, Fits ONE+ ecosystem accessory lineup.
strengths: Compact one-button unit handles quick spot measurements without carrying a full tape
65-foot laser range sufficient for most room and shop dimensions
Pocket-sized body fits in a tool belt or shirt pocket
Lower price than dedicated professional laser measures
limitations: 65-foot laser range shorter than dedicated laser measures
No physical tape, laser only, so very short measurements are less convenient

products.name: Klein Tools 93LDM100C Compact Laser Distance Measure
products.blurb: Key specs: 100-foot (30m) range, Compact single-button design, 1/8-inch accuracy (1/16-inch under 30 feet).
strengths: Compact size is the smallest on this list, fits in a shirt or vest pocket
Klein Tools build quality trusted by electricians and tradespeople
Single-button design, minimal learning curve
Accurate to 1/16 inch for the first 30 feet, the range most woodworking tasks need
limitations: 100-foot range shorter than dedicated long-range models
features: Fits in a shirt or vest pocket
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Bosch GLL3-330CG 360-Degree Three-Plane Green Beam Laser Level
products.blurb: Key specs: 360-degree horizontal and vertical lines, Green beam, visible at up to 100 feet, Self-leveling.
strengths: 360-degree lines for layout work, essential for cabinetry installation and tile work
Green beam visible at up to 100 feet in normal lighting conditions
Self-leveling removes setup time, place, level, shoot
Magnetic bracket attaches to metal studs and framing
limitations: This is a laser level, not a distance measure, different tool from the others on this list
Higher price than basic laser distance measures
features: Green beam, visible at up to 100 feet

products.name: FLIR TG165-X Thermal Imaging Camera with Bullseye Laser
products.blurb: Key specs: Thermal imaging camera, Laser pointer for targeting, Temperature range: -25 to 300°C.
strengths: Thermal imaging identifies moisture intrusion in wood, valuable for identifying problem areas before finishing
Detects heat leaks around shop doors and windows
Laser pointer targets specific spots for temperature reading
limitations: Not a distance measure, completely different function from the rest of this list
Specialty application, not a daily woodworking tool for most

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
